llm_calibration.note: rates are measured against the served context alone; ground truth was never shown to the drafting model. The drafting model and the model that built the harness are the same model, which Section V states as a threat to internal validity.

fit.rule: smallest grid lambda at or above every usable ninety five per cent upper bound

E2.note: pooled k is set to K times the number of routed partitions so that both arrangements see the same number of artefacts

labels.B3P: departmental agents with completeness probe, no lattice

E4.note_multiplicity: four system comparisons times four metrics gives sixteen tests; a Bonferroni corrected threshold at the five per cent level is 0.003125 and is applied when a comparison is described as surviving correction

gas.method: analytical, from the Ethereum yellow paper opcode schedule; no chain measurement was performed
